watchdog_unit: Harness ticks; backend uses its reset-relative cyc*1000ps, not elapsed wall seconds. Reset origins differ; exact backend start unobserved.
interpretation: Conditional cold scenarios exceed PC watchdog; false timeout is possible, not demonstrated. PC-only observations do not prove healthy refill, deadlock or a causal blocker.
terminal_policy: Actual timeout remains failed/incomplete; no numeric/token PASS. Preserve original verdict and raw exit.
next_owner_action: Keep sole live run unchanged. At real terminal harvest existing diagnostic and exit. Any successor needs service-sized watchdog and source-qualified progress units; no second watcher or launch.
